question: Pandavani Folk singer ______ is a Padma Bhushan Awardee of 2003.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teejan Bai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Teejan Bai:-**

 
 
• She is a renowned Pandavani folk singer.
 
• Teejan Bai was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2003, which is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandavani:-**

 
 
• It is a traditional folk art form from Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Odisha, which involves singing and storytelling based on the epic Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Sulakshana Pandit:-**
 
 
• She is a playback singer and actor who has worked in Hindi and Marathi films.
 
 
 
• **Ila Arun:-**
 
 
• She is a folk and pop singer who has sung in various languages, including Hindi, Rajasthani, and Bhojpuri.
 
 
 
• **Mamta Chandrakar:-**
 
 
• She is a Chhattisgarhi folk singer who is known for her soulful renditions of traditional songs.
